description:
## Background

Beadsmith needs a read-only Graph Mode for understanding Issue relationships in the Current Workspace. The existing Issue Explorer snapshot already provides every Issue, explicit parent IDs, and blocking relationships, so this work stays in the renderer and reuses Beadwork as the source of truth.

The implementation must fit the current Issue Navigation and Workspace lifecycle rather than introducing a graph database, a second Issue model, backend graph RPCs, or persisted layouts.

Triage: ready-for-agent after each child issue's blockers are closed.

## What to build

Deliver Graph Mode through session-sized child issues. Graph is a separate sidebar destination whose canvas replaces the Issue List and Issue Detail panes while leaving the sidebar visible. It starts with Current Work plus direct relationship context, can reveal every Issue, distinguishes parent and blocker links, reuses Issue Detail in an overlay, and preserves the user's spatial context within one Current Workspace.

## Technical Approach

Implement in the dependency order below. `bsm-xii.4` is an external prerequisite for Graph routing because it finishes reducing `App` to shell composition and removes the redundant Issue Explorer route switch.

```mermaid
graph LR
    X[bsm-xii.4 Consolidate presentation publication] --> B[Add Graph as an Issue Navigation destination]
    A[Extract reusable Issue Detail presentation] --> F[Open and close Issue Detail over Graph]
    B --> C[Browse the Focused parent hierarchy]
    C --> D[See blocking relationships and incomplete-data warnings]
    D --> E[Reveal every Issue with Show all]
    E --> F
    F --> G[Follow Issue References within Graph]
    G --> H[Preserve the Graph viewport through lifecycle changes]
    H --> I[Prove Graph Mode in the real desktop application]
```

## Considerations

- Parentage comes only from the explicit `parent` field, never dotted Issue IDs.
- Blocking links are derived once from each blocked Issue's `blockedBy` field.
- Parent links determine layout; blocker links never influence positions.
- The existing `allIssues` snapshot is the only graph data source.
- Ready and Blocked remain Beadwork-authored views and are not recomputed from graph links.
- Graph is read-only: no relationship editing, manual arrangement, search, saved layouts, or cross-Workspace relationships.
- Every child must remain independently landable and pass the canonical repository gates.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every child issue is completed in dependency order.
- [ ] Graph Mode satisfies the product contract in `docs/research/graph-mode.md`.
- [ ] No backend graph model, graph RPC, persisted viewport, or second Issue Detail implementation is introduced.
- [ ] List mode, Settings, Workspace switching, refresh, deep links, and Issue Navigation retain their existing behavior.
- [ ] The real desktop Graph → Issue Detail → Close → Back path is proven.
- [ ] React Doctor and `mise run verify` pass at epic completion.

## Test Plan

- Pure unit coverage for graph projection, scope, deterministic layout inputs, and navigation state.
- Focused React coverage for each Graph interaction as it lands.
- Existing List, Workspace, Settings, refresh, and deep-link suites remain regression gates.
- One real desktop scenario proves the completed Graph path against real Beadwork data.
title: Browse Issue relationships in Graph Mode
